description: Shadow mode is reported per descriptor: a value-qualified node that both carries a shadowed limit and owns deeper descriptors reports it enabled, a nested child without the flag reports it disabled, and an unrelated sibling default reports it disabled.

configs.name: config.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: p
    value: pv
    rate_limit:
      unit: minute
      requests_per_unit: 11
    shadow_mode: true
    descriptors:
      - key: q
        rate_limit:
          unit: hour
          requests_per_unit: 12
  - key: r
    rate_limit:
      unit: day
      requests_per_unit: 13

cases.expected_output:
matched=true
full_key=d.p_pv
requests_per_unit=11
unit=MINUTE
unlimited=false
shadow_mode=true
